_description: This file contains application configuration. Changes are automatically detected and applied without restarting the server (hot-reload).
_documentation: For detailed configuration guide, see backend/CONFIGURATION.md

swaggerSpecs._description: Maps API endpoint patterns to their OpenAPI specification URLs
_notes: pattern: URL pattern with wildcard support (e.g., /api/users/* matches /api/users/123)
specUrl: URL to OpenAPI/Swagger specification (JSON or YAML)
Specifications are cached after first load for performance
Patterns are matched in order; first match wins

email._description: Investigation team members who receive error notifications
_notes: All addresses receive notifications for validated error reports
Use distribution lists or group emails when possible
SMTP credentials are configured in .env file

environments._description: List of environments with health check endpoints
environments.name: Production
_notes: name: Display name shown in the frontend dashboard
healthCheckUrl: Endpoint to check environment availability
Health checks run every 60 seconds with 5-second timeout
Environment is 'active' if health check returns 2xx status

_configuration_notes.hot_reload: Changes to this file are automatically detected and applied without server restart
_configuration_notes.validation: Configuration is validated before being applied; invalid changes are rejected
_configuration_notes.required_fields: All sections (swaggerSpecs, email, environments) are required
_configuration_notes.environment_variables: Sensitive credentials (SMTP) are stored in .env file, not here
_configuration_notes.documentation: See backend/CONFIGURATION.md for complete configuration guide
